chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Sindī, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Shuʿayb ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who forgot to pronounce the iqāmah for the salat (prayer) until he had finished and departed: should he repeat his salat (prayer)? He said: “He does not repeat it, and he should not return to the like of it.”

key_terms.لِمِثْلِهَا: to the like of this act
key_terms.يُقِيمَ: to pronounce the iqāmah for salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets the iqāmah before salat (prayer), must the prayer be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the iqāmah before salat (prayer) and only remembers after finishing. The Imam عليه السلام states that the salat (prayer) is not to be repeated, while also warning against being negligent in such a matter again.
